description: This file defines the StatsService class responsible for persisting and retrieving player statistics in a word-guessing game, using the SharedPreferences package for local storage.

classes.name: StatsService
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to load and save player stats using local preferences.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the Stats object from local storage or returns a default Stats instance if not found or on error.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Asynchronously saves the given Stats object to local storage.
